abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 142 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 207 | 600 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 116 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 152 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 192 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 91 | 600 |
